question: How should the wise practitioner place the mantra syllables beginning with praṇava?
premises: The mantra syllables begin with praṇava.
The wise one performs the placement.
Specific body locations are assigned to syllables.
inference: The wise practitioner should place the mantra syllables beginning with oṃ on the specified body parts as instructed.
plain_english: Then the wise one should place the mantra syllables beginning with praṇava. Now the placement of mantra syllables: oṃ ghṛ on the head, oṃ ṇiḥ on the face, oṃ sū on the throat, oṃ ryyaḥ on the heart, oṃ ā on the belly, oṃ di on the private parts, oṃ tyaḥ on the feet. Having thus performed the placements, one should meditate.
